senses.sense_definition: Отделение поликлиники для оказания срочной медицинской помощи при травмах, таких как переломы, вывихи или раны.

examples.text: После падения на льду пришлось срочно ехать в ближайший <w>травмпункт</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: After falling on the ice, I had to rush to the nearest <w>urgent care clinic</w>.

examples.text: Врач в <w>травмпункте</w> быстро наложил гипс на сломанную руку.

target_lang_translations.en: The doctor at the <w>emergency room</w> quickly put a cast on my broken arm.

target_lang_definitions.en: A specialized outpatient clinic or department providing urgent medical care for injuries such as fractures, dislocations, or wounds.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for urgent care, often used for hospital-based trauma services.
A facility for non-life-threatening injuries that require immediate attention.
A specialized facility for severe injuries, though often implies a larger hospital unit.
